name: Leaf of the Seasons
body:
Price 35,280 gp; Slot none; CL 14th; Weight —; Aura strong transmutation

DESCRIPTION

These leaf–shaped brooches come in four types, dedicated to the deities of seasons. Each is beautifully forged in a different metal.

Once per day, on command, a rotating windstorm (see the control winds spell) rises for 1 minute in a 40–feet sphere around the wearer. The wearer can end the wind prematurely if she so desires. Beyond that, the wind carries seasonal storms, depending on the specific leaf worn:

Copper (spring): The wind carries a flurry of flower petals, dazzling and dazing with their scent all creatures as long as they stay in the area of effect.
Gold (summer): The wind carries heavy rain, reducing visibility to 1d10 x 5 ft. and giving a –2 penalty on attacks to all creatures as long as they stay in the area of effect.
Bronze (autumn): Razor–sharp leaves dazzle creatures and inflict them 1d4 points of slashing damage every round they stay in the area of effect.
Silver (winter): A snow blizzard reduces visibility to 1d10 x 5 ft. and deals 1d4 points of cold damage to all creatures every round they stay in the area of effect.

Targets of a leaf of the seasons can negate its effects with a successful DC 17 Fort save.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 17,640 GP Craft Wondrous Item, control weather
